column1: # REESCRITA DO LIMIAR (29/10/2026, AMOSTRA_LIMIAR v3): prólogo, despertar, Cena A, duelo do Rei (C1–C6), queda,
# morte na tela 1 e chegada ao Torpor. Registro: Sophia seca e irônica (contrações); a Voz calorosa; o Rei com
# "nós" majestático, sem contração ("we", "us", formal). Ids C1..C6b do duelo são internos (tradução idêntica).

column2: Shh. It's over. He hits hard for someone who talks so pretty.
Get up. And watch that king who never bows.
(Darkness. A heart beating. Then, the taste of ash.)
Hey. Hey! Wake up. ...That's it, easy. I'm here.
A stone with writing. Read it, if you like. Just don't believe all of it.
Before everything, there was the One. One what? One someone?
The fog is getting thicker. Stay close to me.
You're a voice. Close how?
...Close to my voice, then.
Someone's coming. Relax, I know this one. All pose, weak knees.
Ah. You are awake. We have been waiting.
We who? It's just you there.
A king speaks in the plural. We are too important for the singular.
The law of the Threshold: none pass who do not touch us with their own light.
Touch. Does the staff count?
Try. And fear not: a king never bows.
That bow from before? It was deliberate.
Sure. Super deliberate.
We are not kneeling. We are... resting.
On your knees. In front of me. Never, huh?
(the mask cracks) Your light... is greater than we remembered.
Remembered? I just woke up.
Ask the seven. They remember for us.
Felt that? His seal cracked. Seven thrones just woke up.
Is that good or very bad?
Seven Archons, one per floor. Each one guards a Ring.
And if I gather all seven?
We break this prison. You and me.
(Remembered. Who remembers someone who just woke up?)
Yellow... next time, I parry.
Our light crawls. Jump.
This hand, not even you can parry.
Enough courtesy. Watch the floor.
Always behind you.
Did he just bow? Never, huh?
Never, huh?

The Torpor. Here the dead still don't know they died.
Don't hate the sleepers. Until a moment ago, you were sleeping.
I admit it: lying down sounds great. ...I won't.
(Sleeping is forgetting where you came from. Waking hurts because it's remembering.)
Where am I? ...Worse: who am I?
One question at a time. First, walk. To the right, preferably.
These ashes were people. Your people.
I don't remember a single face. Shouldn't that hurt more?
One day, in a city of ashes, someone woke and heard a gentle voice: “Hey. Wake up. These ashes were your people.”
In the beginning there was a Light so full it overflowed.\nEvery drop that fell became someone.
One of the drops wanted to see the Source alone, without asking.\nFrom what she did, a son was born.\nShe was ashamed. And she hid him.

The son grew up in the dark, certain he was the only one.
He made a world and put a king on every floor.
All of them lie.

Deep in the ashes, someone has just felt pain.
